title.zh: 将奎松省邦多克半岛帕德雷布尔戈斯-阿格当岸-乌尼桑-皮托戈-马卡莱隆-卢纳将军-卡塔纳万-穆拉奈-圣弗朗西斯科-圣安德烈斯-圣纳西索-布埃纳维斯塔国道命名为米格尔苏亚雷斯公路的法案
title.en: An Act Renaming the Padre Burgos - Agdangan - Unisan - Pitogo - Macalelon - General Luna - Catanauan - Mulanay - San Francisco - San Andres - San Narciso - Buenavista National Road in Bondoc Peninsula in the Province of Quezon as the Miguel Suarez Highway
title.orig: An Act Renaming the Padre Burgos - Agdangan - Unisan - Pitogo - Macalelon - General Luna - Catanauan - Mulanay - San Francisco - San Andres - San Narciso - Buenavista National Road in Bondoc Peninsula in the Province of Quezon as the Miguel Suarez Highway

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2004/ra_9251_2004.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Padre Burgos - Agdangan - Unisan - Pitogo - Macalelon - General Luna - Catanauan - Mulanay - San Franciso - San Andres - San Narciso - Buenavista National Road in Bondoc Peninsula in the Province of Quezon shall hereafter be known as the Miguel Suarez Highway.
The Act shall take effect upon its approval.
